We have search results with several templates. Need to find one that when applied to the given molecule (initial_molecule) reproduces the reaction: carboxylic acid to amide (amide formation). The forward reaction is carboxylic acid + amine -> amide (coupling). In retrosynthesis, we break amide to carboxylic acid and amine.

We need to return mapped_rxn and template_id (integer). The search results include reaction_id, template_hash, etc. But we need template_id (the one used to search the database not the hash). The tool returns reaction_id? It includes reaction_id field. Probably template_id is reaction_id? The description: "template_id (the one used to search the database not the hash)". In search results, each entry has 'reaction_id' and 'template_hash'. Likely template_id corresponds to reaction_id. So we need to pick appropriate template that matches our target.

We need to check which template matches our molecule. The initial molecule: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1

It contains an amide: C(=O)N attached to aromatic ring (c3ccccc3N). The amide carbonyl is attached to a conjugated double bond (C=C). The carboxylic acid precursor would be C(=O)OH? The template should break amide to acid and amine.

From search results, look at each entry's retro_smarts_template. For example entry 1: retro_smarts_template: '[#7:2]-[C;H0;D3;+0:1](=[O;D1;H0:3])/[CH;D2;+0:4]=[C:5]>>C-C(-C)(-C)-O-[C;H0;D3;+0:1](-[#7:2])=[O;D1;H0:3].O-C(=O)-[CH;D2;+0:4]=[C:5]'

That seems to be amide to acid? It shows forward direction? The retro template is amide -> acid + something? The left side is amide with alkenyl? It includes [#7:2]-[C...](=[O...])/[CH...]=[C:5] which is amide attached to alkene. Right side is t-butyl ester? Not exactly.

Second entry: retro_smarts_template: '[#7:5]-[C;H0;D3;+0:1](=[O;D1;H0:2])-[C:3]=[C:4]>>O-[C;H0;D3;+0:1](=[O;D1;H0:2])-[C:3]=[C:4]'

That is amide to acid? It shows amide (N-C=O) attached to alkene? Right side is O-C(=O)-C=C (acid). That seems plausible.

Third entry: similar.

We need to verify which template matches our molecule. Use check_smiles_reaction_template_matching with each template_id? But we need template_id. The search result doesn't give template_id directly. Might be reaction_id? Let's try check for first entry's reaction_id 401931. Use check_smiles_reaction_template_matching with that ID.
